description: The ranked athletes for one statistical category across a state or nationally — up to 200 per board, each with their full stat line, school, and a `teamPath` for the other team tools. Take `path` from maxpreps_list_stat_categories rather than constructing it. If MaxPreps changes the row shape the rows are returned undecoded with a warning rather than mislabelled. Read-only.
name: maxpreps_get_stat_leaderboard
title: Get a MaxPreps stat leaderboard
